angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 718,762 km at 150.62 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.6391 +/- 0.0208 mas (same row, RUWE 1.21): 150.62 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.03315 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5160 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 718,762 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.926 (0.884 to 0.968) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5622.14 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5160 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5160 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5160.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.376, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TYC 2453-554-1: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5160 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.204 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5160 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.00776, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 880230839824089600, flags_flame 00: age_flame 9.957456 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 8.253191 to 11.651785)
